notes.title: V1.2 PC update released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Here's another update with various small fixes :)

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed the Totummy guard showing you the wrong icon for the right analogue stick.
[*] Fixed horizontal stick directions not being set as fallbacks (when you mapped something else to left/right in the controls screen)
[*] In the multiplayer Totummy mission, fixed one of the stars not being counted, added an extra checkpoint and fixed a trapdoor stealing the camera.
[*] Added a multiplayer accolade for whoever did the most barks!
[*] Fixed accolades having flipped numbers in Arabic.
[*] Fixed some text overflowing on the multiplayer results screen (in French, Spanish, Portuguese)
[*] Bingo no longer says to 'look out for cassettedisks' if you already found them all.
[*] Fixed the Mall extermination achievement being missable if you let Bug Hero kill the last beastie.
[*] Made it easier to input certain secret codes even if you remapped your controls.
[*] Fixed a line of junk pixels occasionally appearing under the multiplayer pause menu.
[*] Increased the spawn rectangle on the cacti in Resonarion so they don't pop-in.
[*] Fixed a possible rare bug in the audio mixer when returning from the credits to the title screen.
[*] Made it possible to exit the fishing game by pressing Esc on the keyboard, as the icon suggests.
[*] Fixed Blue Yamo's friend card being missable if you exited the game at the wrong time.
[*] Fixed the quest indicator to talk to Bingo not showing up if your last cassettedisk was the one you get from talking to [spoiler]Azure[/spoiler] with all [spoiler]Oranges[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed the [spoiler]Xenorat[/spoiler] behaviour so they no longer get stuck in the light.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1 PC update released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This is a minor release to fix the handful of bugs encountered since launching on PC a few days ago!

Thanks so much to everyone who's played our game so far, it really means the world to us! :D

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash on the title screen if you last saved in the Orange Dimension.
[*] If you died while catching a [spoiler]Xenorat[/spoiler], you will now still get the achievement.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where dust effects would make Maxwell visible when he's supposed to be hiding behind foreground tiles.
[*] Fixed wrong keyboard key shown for 'exit' in the rhythm game pause menu.
[*] Fixed wrong icon for the 'share' button on PS4/5 controllers.
[*] Fixed the drill sound effect getting stuck if you used the radial menu (right analogue stick) to change weapon while drilling.
[*] Fixed a softlock in the no-shield route on Resonarion.
[*] Fixed a softlock in the multiplayer Outpost Basement mission (if you looped around instead of following the intended path).
[*] Added a camera hint in Plestro's warehouse to make one of the flying enemies less unfair to dodge.
[/list]
